verdict.rationale: Contract-lifecycle tracking is a fair question for a legal-services platform, but the evidence shows no contract renewal, expiration, or obligation tracking. The only alerts documented are Compliance Calendar reminders for annual report deadlines and registered-agent mail notifications. Those are adjacent entity-compliance features, not contract alerts, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can track contract renewals, expirations, and obligations with automatic alerts
